name: RetroAchievements offline cache
description: Cache games for offline play, watch new games, and show each game's own icon.

name: Handheld picture
description: Game Boy, Game Boy Color, and GBA on a 640x480 screen, with sharp-shimmerless and a Perfect frame.

name: Console picture
description: NES, SNES, and Genesis fill a 640x480 screen with sharp-shimmerless, so the pixels stay even. No frame. Covers every core those systems offer.

name: N64
description: Keeps LudicrousN64 fast for RetroAchievements, and gives Paper Mario and Donkey Kong 64 settings that stop their glitches and freezes.

name: N64 D-pad as stick
description: Adds a Stick row to the N64 menu. Left stick and D-pad makes the D-pad drive the N64 stick too. Left stick puts the D-pad back. The left stick stays mapped either way.

name: Save manager
description: An Apps menu entry that lists battery saves and savestates, deletes the ones you choose, and backs them up to Google Drive, including on a timer.

name: Hotkey list
description: Adds a Hotkeys row to Settings that lists the button chords this device is using.

name: Display presets
description: Moves Display settings to the top Settings menu, and adds Default and Dimmest presets. Default restores the stock picture. Dimmest uses the lowest lit backlight, brightness 8, and contrast 2.
